ajay: Quick check — what's the authoritative priority when a request sets model_pin, region_hint and tier? We're seeing subtle differences between local routing and the gateway.

sasha: model_pin wins always. After that: region_hint is applied, then tier. That's the intended order.

paul: to be explicit: model_pin -> region_hint -> tier -> fallback_variants. If pinned model isn't available in region, we try compatible variant in same region, then cross-region if policy allows.

maria: @sasha can you confirm whether tier overrides cross-region allowedness? I.e. should a premium request be allowed to go cross-region before a lower-tier local match?

sasha: short: no. We don't escalate region for tier. Tier only affects which queue/pool you hit *within* a region. Cross-region is a fallback if region can't serve at all.

ajay: thanks. Can we add an example response shape to the API contract so clients can know which served_model fields to look for?

paul: +1. Proposed snippet for the contract (for docs/clients):
```json
{
  "request_id": "r_123",
  "served_model": {
    "id": "rwd-1-large-v2",
    "variant": "q4_0",
    "region": "eu-west-1",
    "tier": "standard",
    "fallback_chain": ["rwd-1-large-v2", "rwd-1-large-q4", "rwd-1-medium-v1"]
  }
}
```

maria: perfect. also suggest adding a short paragraph about backward compatibility when we change variant names (eg q4_0 -> q4_1). Clients should prefer served_model.id over their requested model string.

sasha: agreed. we'll state that served_model.id is the ground truth for runtime behavior. Any client logic should read served_model.variant and id, not assume mapping from request fields.

ajay: small ops/coord ping — I opened a tiny PR that adds the contract + example and a unit test for the router. @sasha @paul can you take a quick look when you have a minute? link: https://git.local/r/redwood/inference/pulls/4821

ci-bot: build #4821 showed a lint failure in router_test.go: fmt mismatch on TestRoutingPriority. See CI logs: https://ci.local/builds/4821/log

paul: i'll fix the fmt change now. ETA 20m.

maria: also, quick Q for product — do we want to guarantee that fallback_chain always includes cross-region entries, or only when cross-region is allowed by tenant policy?

sasha: only when tenant policy permits. Add policy flag in response like `cross_region_allowed: true|false` in served_model metadata.

ajay: got it. i'll update the PR to include `cross_region_allowed` and a short note in the contract about tenant policy semantics.

paul: pushed fmt fix and updated tests. CI re-run queued. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all. If CI passes I'll merge and add a short entry in the release notes about the new `served_model` shape so SDKs can adapt.

ajay: thanks — resolving for now, will follow up if anything from SDKs pops up. :rocket:
